questions.text: What did you do before you died?

who_are_you: I am... just a simple person who tried to live a good life.
how_died: It was sudden. An accident, they said.
I didn't even see it coming.
before_death: I was on my way to visit my mother.
She was sick, and I wanted to be there for her.
guilty: Guilty? I... I don't think so.
I tried my best to be kind to everyone.

items.name: Faded Photo
items.description: A worn photograph of an elderly woman smiling.
items.description_zh: 一张老妇人微笑的磨损照片。
dialogue: This is my mother...
I never got to say goodbye.

items.name: Bus Ticket
items.description: A one-way bus ticket, dated the day of death.
items.description_zh: 一张单程公交车票，日期是死亡当天。
dialogue: The 7:15 bus...
If only I had taken the later one.

who_are_you: I was a doctor. Spent thirty years saving lives.
how_died: Heart gave out during a surgery. Ironic, isn't it?
before_death: I was operating on a child.
A little girl with a congenital heart defect.
My colleagues finished the surgery. She survived.
guilty: Every life I saved was worth every sacrifice.

items.name: Stethoscope
items.description: A well-used stethoscope, worn smooth from years of use.
items.description_zh: 一副使用多年的听诊器，已经磨得光滑。
dialogue: I've listened to thousands of heartbeats with this.
Each one a life trusting me.

how_died: Decided to terminate our partnership permanently.
guilty: Guilty of what? Making a living?
Everyone does what they have to do.

items.name: Ledger Book
items.description: A leather-bound ledger with coded entries.
items.description_zh: 一本皮革装订的账本，里面是编码的条目。
dialogue: Every transaction recorded.
Some things are better left in code.

before_death: I was... taking care of a problem.
A permanent solution, you might say.
guilty: I did what needed to be done.
The weak exist to serve the strong.

items.name: Bloodstained Ring
items.description: A gold signet ring with dark stains that won't wash off.
items.description_zh: 一枚金印戒，上面有洗不掉的黑色污渍。
dialogue: This ring has seen many... negotiations.
It's amazing how persuasive a little pressure can be.

how_died: I went back in for the children.
before_death: I counted heads... one was missing.
guilty: Maybe that makes me guilty of not being enough.

items.name: Class Photo
items.description: A class photo with 24 smiling children.
items.description_zh: 一张有24个孩子微笑的班级合照。
dialogue: 23 of them made it out.
I found the 24th hiding under a desk.

how_died: We knew it was coming, but there were still people inside.
guilty: I chose this life knowing the risks.
I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

items.name: Melted Badge
items.description: A firefighter's badge, partially melted from intense heat.
items.description_zh: 一枚消防员徽章，因高温部分熔化。
dialogue: This badge meant everything to me.
It represents every life we've saved.

who_are_you: I uncovered truths people didn't want known.
how_died: Someone didn't like my latest story.
I got too close to the truth.
guilty: I ruined lives with my stories.
But they deserved it... didn't they?

items.name: USB Drive
items.description: An encrypted USB drive containing sensitive files.
items.description_zh: 一个加密U盘，包含敏感文件。
dialogue: The truth is on here.
But truth can be a weapon too.

who_are_you: I played violin on the corner.
how_died: I gave my coat to someone who needed it more.
before_death: A lullaby for a homeless child.
guilty: I had nothing to give but music.

items.name: Broken Violin
items.description: A violin with a cracked body but intact strings.
items.description_zh: 一把琴身破裂但琴弦完好的小提琴。
dialogue: Music was all I had.
But it was enough to make people smile.

how_died: Someone sabotaged it. Poetic justice, perhaps.
guilty: You can't make an empire without breaking a few lives.

items.name: Golden Pen
items.description: An expensive pen that has signed countless contracts.
items.description_zh: 一支昂贵的钢笔，签署过无数合同。
dialogue: This pen has ended more careers than I can count.
And started a few fortunes too.
